contexts.text: The Lord has deigned to say.
The Lord deigned... to assume human nature.
Temptations... are attended with the belief that others are more worthy than ourselves.
To those who eat and drink (the Holy Supper) worthily, eternal life is appropriated; but those who eat and drink it unworthily, appropriate to themselves death.
Those are the first (in Heaven) who... had not believed themselves worthy of mercy.
The prodigal's confession that he was not worthy to be called his son () = repentance of heart, and humiliation.

They who are in truths from the Lord, because they have been conjoined with Him, are called worthy; for in the Spiritual World all worthiness is from conjunction with the Lord. (Thus) they shall walk with Me in white, because they are worthy () = that they will live with the Lord, because they are in truths from Him. ( = their spiritual life, which they have through the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word. AE 196.)
Thou art worthy Lord () = the merit and righteousness that belong to the Lord's Human. AE 293. AE 293:3.
Who is worthy to open the Book... () = who has the power to know the states of life of all... AE 303. AR 280. AR 288. AE 306. AE 327.
For they are worthy () = that (such) are in evils as to life; and evil effects this in them. ( = that it is done to them as they do. AE 977.)
All who approach the Holy Communion worthily, become His redeemed.
That the Lord... opens Heaven to those who approach the Holy Supper worthily... General article.
That those approach it worthily who are in faith in the Lord, and charity towards the neighbour, thus who are regenerate. General article.
That those who approach it worthily are in the Lord and the Lord in them... General article.
That to those who approach it worthily, the Holy Supper is a signing and sealing that they are sons of God. General article.
In proportion as anyone receives from the Lord, he is worthy; but in proportion as he receives from self, he is not worthy.
Worthy is the Lamb... () = acknowledgement at heart that everything Divine is from the Lord's Divine Human.
